verdict.rationale: Jules's own docs show you can assign a task straight from a GitHub issue by adding the "jules" label, which covers the core of the story for GitHub issues. Support for other ticket systems such as Linear appears only as something you could build yourself with the API, so it earns no credit. The issue-label flow is a single thin marketing-page mention with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: native assignment from non-GitHub tickets (e.g. Linear/Jira), detailed documentation of how the issue-label trigger works and how issue context feeds the task, independent or hands-on corroboration of the label workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket

citations.quote: Use the "jules" label in an issue to assign a task directly in GitHub.
